name: Goblin Sponsorship
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, the goblin racers still need their missing fuel regulator. Wharfmaster Lozgil sends you to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay for help.

sections.title: Asking the Baron
sections.body: Wharfmaster Lozgil can do little more to trace the missing shipment bound for Ratchet. He sends you to Baron Revilgaz, since the Baron knows his own business best. You will find him on the top floor of the tavern across the harbor in Booty Bay.

sections.title: The Baron's Answer
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz knows about the missing fuel regulator but cannot help. Some of his men went to find its blueprints and returned empty-handed.

faq.q: Where can I find Baron Revilgaz?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz is on the top floor of the tavern across the harbor in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why does Wharfmaster Lozgil send you to Revilgaz?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Lozgil can do little more to help, and says the Baron knows his own business best.

faq.q: What shipment is being tracked down?
faq.answer: The shipment is a new fuel regulator bound for Ratchet, for the goblin racers of the Mirage Raceway.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
faq.answer: This follows your talk with Wharfmaster Lozgil in Goblin Sponsorship two. The next step is Goblin Sponsorship four.
